what: On first open, below a contrast stage-color curtain, the wordmark letters rise one by one at .06s intervals over .7s power3.out from beneath their own cells. Then the wordmark in the curtain and the same wordmark on the page rise into place together over 1s power2.inOut. At the same time the curtain lifts from the bottom edge upward (.25s late, .8s), the background-color panel beneath lifts next (.4s late, .9s), and the first photo settles from 1.7x to 1x (.4s late, 1.4s power2.out). Where the curtain lifted, the wordmark stays as the hero title

options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Wordmark inside the curtain (child of curtain) — its children (letter slots) rise one by one
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: (optional) background color panel beneath the curtain — covers the first photo spot, then lifts away
options.page: Page wordmark selector — if the user’s CSS lowers it by --fx-drop, it rises to y 0 together with the wordmark in the scrim
options.zoom: (Optional) Selector for the first photo that enlarges big and then settles
options.--fx-top / --fx-left / --fx-right: Wordmark slot inside the curtain (css variable) — same position as the page wordmark
options.--fx-drop: Distance the two wordmarks start lowered (css variable, e.g. calc(100dvh - 43.4rem))
options.wait: Time waiting with only the curtain laid (sec), default 1.2
options.rise: Time for one letter to rise (s), default .7
options.lift: Duration for the two wordmarks to rise (sec), default 1
options.zoom-from / zoom-dur / zoom-delay: First photo’s starting scale, length and delay, defaults 1.7 · 1.4 · .4
options.session: When 1, from the second visit in the same tab it goes straight to the end state without the curtain (name saved by key)

use: WO…
note: Events — fx:start (text starts rising, when locking scroll), fx:lift (wordmark starts rising — play the first video here), fx:done (lifted up to the panel, when releasing scroll). The wordmark in the curtain and the page wordmark must have the same letters and size so they rise overlapped

from.where: index.html [data-slot=loader] — the original index loading() (setTimeout 1200 → u-typo y .7s power3.out stagger .06 → [typography, loadingTypography] y 0 1s power2.inOut · loadingTypographyWrapper clip-path .25s later .8s · loadingWhiteBg .4s later .9s · indexMvLoadingWrapper scale 1.7→1 .4s later 1.4s power2.out, sessionStorage isLoaded)
